 New product recalls issued for items sold at major Canadian stores: Costco, Walmart, Winners, HomeSense, Best Buy and more

 By Evelyn Harford Insidehaltoncom

 Health Canada issued new product recall notices for space heaters sold at Costco, clothing sold on Shein, a Baby Brezza bottle sanitizer sold at Winners, Marshalls, HomeSense and Amazon, Bose battery packs sold through Best Buy and Amazon, antacid tablets sold at Walmart and more.
 Baby Brezza SuperFast Sterilizer Dryer 
 Issue Burn and fire risk
 Where sold 6,001 units of the affected products were sold in Canada through Amazon, Winners, HomeSense and Marshalls; 29,000 were sold in the United States between September 2023 and November 2026.
 What to do Immediately stop using. Contact EI Brand Management Inc. for instructions on how to get a free replacement.
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 Baby Brezza SuperFast Sterilizer Dryer recalled due to fire and burn risk.
 Health Canada 
 Product details 
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 Product name Baby Brezza SuperFast Sterilizer Dryer
 Model no. BRZ0083
 UPC 886267008313
 Place of origin  Manufactured in China
 News 
 Product recall issued for item sold through Amazon, Winners, HomeSense and Marshalls 
 Evelyn Harford 
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 Bibihou Mermaid Princess Dress 
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW
 Issue Flammability risk
 Where sold In Canada through Shein
 What to do Immediately stop using and throw out in a way it can’t be used again. Contact Shein for a refund. 
 Mermaid Princess Dress recalled due to flammability hazard.
 Health Canada 
 Product details 
 Product name Bibihou Mermaid Princess Dress
 Material 100 per cent polyester
 Colours Blue, green and purple 
 Description Spaghetti strap dress with ruffles at the shoulder, waist and skirt bottom
 News 
 Princess dress sold on SHEIN recalled in Canada as it could catch fire rapidly: Here’s how to get a refund 
 Evelyn Harford 
 Newdery power banks 
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 Issue: Fire hazard
 Where sold: 962 units of the affected products were sold in Canada on Amazon.ca between June 2024 and November 2024.
 What to do: Immediately stop using the recalled power banks. Impacted customers have been refunded through Amazon.ca , the recall notice explains. However, if you have questions, or think you didn’t get a refund, contact Newdery .
 NEWDERY Power Banks 
 Product details 
 Product name: Newdery Power Banks
 Model: ZHX-PB22
 Description: The recalled power banks have a clear plastic shell in the front showing a black interior with two yellow cables attached to a black exterior shell.
 News 
 Power banks sold on Amazon Canada recalled — why your refund may already be issued 
 Evelyn Harford 
 Bose S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ System Battery Packs 
 Issue Potentially damaging operating conditions, posing potential fire and burn hazards.
 Where sold The company reported that 35,399 units of the affected products were sold in Canada, including through Best Buy and Amazon; 634,759 were sold in the United States.
 What to do Immediately remove and stop using the recalled battery packs and contact Bose Corporation to get a replacement battery pack.
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 Bose S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ System Battery Packs have been recalled.
 Health Canada 
 Bose S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ System Battery Packs have been recalled.
 Health Canada 
 Product details 
 Product name Bose S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ System Battery Packs
 The impacted battery packs are lithium-ion rechargeable battery packs and designed for exclusive use in Bose S1 Pro Portable Bluetooth Speaker System and S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth Speaker System.
 Impacted battery packs 
 The affected battery packs have the following serial numbers begin with these six digits:
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 083723
 078352
 084105
 078591
 078592
 084106
 086409
 News 
 Bose battery packs recalled in Canada: What Ontario shoppers should know 
 Evelyn Harford 
 Equate Ultra Strength Antacid Assorted Fruits tablets 
 Issue May contain metal fragments (stainless steel shavings)
 Where sold Nationally in Canada, including through Amazon and Walmart
 What to do Talk to your health-care provider before stopping use of the affected product or for any health concerns.
 Product details 
 Brand: Equate
 Product name: Equate Ultra Strength Antacid Assorted Fruits
 Market authorization: NPN 80125051
 Dosage form: Tablet, chewable
 Strength: 1,000 mg
 Lot number: 1716089
 No image of the product was published with Health Canada’s recall notice.
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 News 
 Health Canada issues product recall notice for Equate antacid tablets sold at Walmart over possible metal fragments 
 Evelyn Harford 
 Dreo space heaters
 Issue Fire and burn risks
 Where sold 36,288 units of the affected products were sold in Canada and 338,800 were sold in the United States from September 2025 to August 2026. Units were sold through Costco and Amazon.
 What to do Immediately stop using and contact Dreo to receive a free replacement space heater.
 DREO space heater 
 Product detail  
 Product Dreo portable oscillating ceramic space heaters that include a remote control
 Model no. DR-HSH015
 Manufacturing dates Affected units were manufactured from April 2025 (2025/04) to January 2026 (2026/01).
 Colour Black
 Measurements 29 cm wide by 33 cm tall
 Costco item no. 1910772
 Place of origin Vietnam 
 News 
 Product recall issued for item sold through Costco in Canada 
 Evelyn Harford 
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 Leakbee Carbon Monoxide Detector 
 Issue: Potentially inaccurate readings.
 Where sold: 856 units of the affected products were sold in Canada, including on Amazon, from January 2026 to May 2026.
 What to do: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and email Yizhoukeji at yizhouusa@163.com for a refund.
 Leakbee Carbon Monoxide Detector 
 Product details 
 Product name: Leakbee Carbon Monoxide Detector
 Model no.: YC302
 Description: The detector is encased in a white plastic housing with the model number printed on a sticker located on the back of the unit.
 News 
 Carbon monoxide detectors recalled in Canada over poisoning risk 
 Evelyn Harford 
 Link Product Solutions ‘Fright Night Organza Costume Wings​’ 
 Issue Ingestion risk.
 Where sold 432 units of the affected products were sold in Canada between July 2026 and September 2026.
 What to do Immediately stop using the product, keep out of reach of children and throw it out.
 Link Product Solutions Fright Night Organza Costume Wings recalled due to ingestion hazard.
 Health Canada 
 Product details 
 The wings themselves aren’t impacted. The identified hazard is associated with the LED box only.
 Product name Fright Night Organza Wings.
 Colour lights LED lights could be bought in black, white, red, pink, fuchsia and purple
 Contains Comes with three LR44 batteries
 Place of origin Manufactured in China
 News 
 Halloween costume wings recalled in Canada over button battery risk 
 Evelyn Harford 
 How to report an issue with a consumer product, drug, cannabis or food
 You can report a food concern or complaint to the Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA) online.
 Consumers can report any health or safety incidents related to the use of products by filling out a consumer product incident report form .
 To report a health or safety complaint with a cannabis product, fill out the cannabis reporting form online.
 Report any drug or health product side effects or complaints to Health Canada.
 You can check for more recall notices published by Health Canada and CFIA online .
